purpose: Historical rule timing and explicit-trigger interpretation, not causal attribution or a new model input calendar

sources.title: 上海证券交易所就退市制度修订答记者问
sources.verified_fact: 1元股价条件及3亿元市值条件在2024改革之前已存在；财务组合指标和扣除口径亦须依原规则判断。

sources.title: 证监会发布《关于严格执行退市制度的意见》
sources.verified_fact: 改革包括严格退市标准及削减壳资源价值；这是政策目标和机制依据，不是本样本的估计政策效果。

sources.title: 上海证券交易所股票上市规则2024年4月修订发布通知及过渡安排
sources.verified_fact: 主板市值调整自2024-10-30施行，跨日延续的旧3亿元情形有过渡安排；不能根据入组年份直接赋新门槛。
sources.access: initial open timed out; official indexed full notice retrieved by focused search

sources.title: 深圳证券交易所股票上市规则2024年修订发布通知及过渡安排
sources.verified_fact: 市值规则有2024-10-30及旧情形过渡安排；相关财务规则以2024会计年度为首个适用年度，不能把2024春季的2023年报全部按新规则处理。

limits: Case trigger categories are supported by existing private terminal-announcement text and source IDs, not date-only assignment.
No stock-market path counterfactual was computed; citing a five-hundred-million trigger does not prove the company would survive under a three-hundred-million trigger.
A later rule version with financial/audit triggers does not by itself identify the incremental effect of the 2024 reform.
This is not a complete historical rule engine across all boards or 2012-2026. Individual raw decisions and original annual-report vintages are still required for formal PIT feature construction.
